title: Situation in the State of Palestine
note: Official ICC page for investigation and court decisions.

title: Displaced Persons and Zionism
note: Explains why many Jewish survivors viewed Palestine as their desired destination after the Holocaust.

title: Holocaust Survivors and the Establishment of Israel
note: Connects the refugee crisis, UN partition, statehood and post-1948 immigration.

title: Jewish Messianism
note: Introduces ingathering, peace, Jerusalem, redemption and diverse Jewish understandings of the messianic age.

title: Israel Antiquities Authority — Discovery and Publication of the Dead Sea Scrolls
note: Official account of the 1947 discovery, eleven caves, fragments and publication history.

title: Israel Antiquities Authority — Languages and Scripts
note: Explains Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek manuscripts, palaeography and dating.

title: Israel Museum — The Great Isaiah Scroll
note: Interactive presentation of the complete Great Isaiah Scroll, approximately 125 BCE.

title: Library of Congress — The Dead Sea Scrolls Today
note: Explains the Scrolls’ importance for the Hebrew Bible, Second Temple Judaism and the background of Christianity.

title: Cell — Genetic Analysis of Dead Sea Scroll Parchment
note: Uses parchment DNA to help group fragments and investigate manuscript origins.

title: Pew Research Center — Jewish Americans in 2020
note: Large survey of Jewish identity, belonging, practice, family and intermarriage in the United States.

title: Pew Research Center — Marriage, Families and Children among U.S. Jews
note: Reports intermarriage and child-rearing patterns, useful for studying assimilation and continuity.

title: USHMM — The Farhud
note: Documents the 1941 anti-Jewish violence in Baghdad and the context of the later mass departure of Iraqi Jews.

title: United Nations — History of the Question of Palestine
note: Documents Mandate, partition, wars, refugees and diplomacy from a UN archival perspective.

title: UN OCHA — Humanitarian Situation Updates
note: Date-sensitive humanitarian reporting for Gaza and the West Bank; figures should be checked live.

title: International Court of Justice — South Africa v. Israel
note: Official pleadings, orders and procedural status. Allegations, provisional measures and final judgments must be distinguished.

title: Natural History Museum — What Is a Fossil?
note: Explains why fossilisation is rare and why the fossil record is necessarily incomplete.

title: Natural History Museum — What Can Scientists Learn about Dinosaurs?
note: Shows how partial remains, geology, anatomy and multiple traces converge in scientific reconstruction.

title: Ligonier — Interpreting Revelation
note: Summarises preterist, historicist, idealist, futurist and eclectic approaches.

title: The Gospel Coalition — Perspectives on Israel and the Church: Four Views
note: Introduces major covenantal, dispensational and mediating approaches.

title: Yale Bible Study — Revelation
note: Free academic course on Revelation’s historical setting, imagery and theological interpretation.

title: Cambridge — What Kinds of Problems Do Historians Solve?
note: Explains reasoning from incomplete, indirect and sometimes conflicting evidence.
